title: GetEnduranceAV - Game
content:
Member of: Game Script

Obtains the Endurance Actor Actor Value.

Syntax:
ActorValue Function GetEnduranceAV() native global

Parameters:
None

Return Value:
The Endurance Actor Actor Value.

Examples:
Game.GetPlayer().SetValue( Game.GetEnduranceAV(), 3 )

- Game Script
